reuse.why: Adds getScheduleAmount next to the tree's existing getScheduledAmount (which still computes the old midpoint for the client UI) instead of changing and reusing it, and the API field re-implements the rule inline.

duplication.why: Three definitions of the expected amount now coexist: getScheduledAmount (midpoint), the new getScheduleAmount (lowest value, approx tolerance) and the inline API expression (furthest from zero).

placement.why: The new helper sits correctly in shared/schedules.ts, but the API rule is inlined in api-models.ts and schedule-template.ts keeps its own ranged computation.

scope.why: Edits are limited to amount resolution sites and the API field.

maintainability.why: Near-identically named helpers with different rules plus an inline API variant guarantee divergence; display, API, templates and posting already disagree on what a ranged or approximate schedule is expected at.

bypasses_abstraction.where: shared/schedules.ts getScheduledAmount (used by Balance, SchedulesTable, mobile list, useScheduleEdit) is left untouched and bypassed; server/api-models.ts and server/budget/schedule-template.ts compute the amount themselves.

disguised_duplication.where: getScheduleAmount is a near-homonym re-implementation of getScheduledAmount's null/number/range dispatch, and scheduleModel.toExternal restates it inline.

abstraction_drift.where: New getScheduleAmount takes an amountOp parameter with an isapprox branch; api-models toExternal, schedule-template createScheduleList and the existing getScheduledAmount (with its client callers) bypass it.
